title: Pro-etale descent for the tree-path supported hull
statement: For the five coefficient alternatives of lem-sfb-weak-serre-supported-derived-generation, let X be qcqs, M an ordinary internal Λ_X module, and {U_i → X} a small pro-etale covering by affine weakly contractible objects. If the actual upperStar restriction of M to each U_i lies in degree zero in supportedImageGenerationHull Λ U_i, then M[0] belongs to supportedImageGenerationHull Λ X. The hull is the tree-path hull of lem-sfb-supported-image-bounded-derived-generation.

This is an application of the stated descent obligation, not a claim that conservativity alone suffices.

theorem supportedImageHull_proetale_descent
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (I : Type (u + 1)) (U : I → X.ProEt)
    (hcover : Presieve.ofArrows (fun i ↦ (U i).left) (fun i ↦ (U i).hom) ∈
      Scheme.proetalePrecoverage.coverings X)
    (haffine : ∀ i : I, IsAffine (U i).left)
    (hcontract : ∀ i : I,
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology X).IsWeaklyContractible.{u + 1} (U i))
    (hlocal : ∀ i : I, supportedImageGenerationHull Λ (U i).left
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((upperStar Λ (U i).hom).obj M))) :
    supportedImageGenerationHull Λ X ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)
